name: Asahina Miki
source: A cheerful young woman who works as a nurse in the Mizukoshi hospital, taking care for little fidgety [url=/c5971]Yuzu[/url]. When studied at Kazami School, she was a classmate and best friend of [url=/c5967]Mahiru[/url]. Miki regularly came to the hospital to visit her terminally ill friend and cheer her up in every possible way.
